title: Ambit configuration
description: Named file scopes for Ambit. Relative paths are resolved from the directory containing ambit.yaml. Parent references, inheritance cycles, empty leaf scopes, and filesystem matches are checked by ambit validate.

set.title: File scope
set.description: Paths and exclusions are additive across parents. All properties are optional; empty lists keep inherited entries.

paths.description: Included files, directories, or glob patterns. Patterns containing * use PHP glob(); ** is not recursive.

exclude.description: Excluded paths or patterns using Rector-style prefix/suffix and fnmatch() matching. A trailing / prevents literal directory exclusions from matching siblings with the same prefix.

extends.description: Parent set name or list of parent names. Inherited paths and exclusions are merged in declaration order before this set's entries.
